summary: ZW Data Action Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose that Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) minimum bid price requirement. The company had received a deficiency notice in March 2026 due to bid price below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. Nasdaq verified the closing bid price was at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (August 3-14, 2026), closing the matter. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. The company issued a press release on August 18, 2026. No deal terms, transactions, or structural changes are involved; what to watch is continued price maintenance above $1.00 to avoid future delisting risk.
